criteria.label: Fidelity and completeness
criteria.guidance: Preserves the article's meaningful body, metadata, ordering, quotations, lists, tables, code, captions, and other source elements appropriate to the selected format.

criteria.label: Body selection and furniture exclusion
criteria.guidance: Includes the intended article while excluding navigation, promotions, consent UI, related-content furniture, comments, and duplicated responsive content.

criteria.label: Format-specific compliance
criteria.guidance: TXT is TTS-friendly plain text only; Markdown is a faithful non-image text recreation; PDF is a legible full extraction whose selected images appear in the right locations.

criteria.label: Ordering and coherence
criteria.guidance: Reads in source order with intact sentences and sections, including multicolumn or interactive sources.

criteria.label: Runtime and reliability
criteria.guidance: Completes without errors or partial artifacts and meets the format's performance target.

txt: Contains only title, subtitle, byline, date, headings, prose, quotations, and plain - or numbered lists when present.
Contains no Markdown heading, emphasis, blockquote, divider, image-marker, link-destination, caption, or raw HTML syntax.
md: Faithfully uses Markdown hierarchy, emphasis, links, lists, quotations, tables, code, separators, footnotes, equations, and textual captions when present.
Contains no embedded image or REE image marker.
pdf: Text is searchable, links are clickable, Unicode renders correctly, and pagination has no clipping or overlap.
Tables, code, figures, captions, page transitions, and image scaling are legible; no black boxes or missing glyphs are visible.
